key_catalyst: Broad memory and storage chip selloff driven by doubts about the durability of the AI memory supercycle
reasoning: A broad 8-9% memory/storage-chip selloff and falling semiconductor indices despite TSMC's strong beat indicate a novel reassessment of AI hardware demand durability, while fresh U.S.-Iran strikes and oil above $85 add an unresolved macro risk. The market previously reacted sharply to similar escalation on July 13, and today's bullish PPI, Apple, and TSMC news has not fully offset the sector damage.
